tour.manuscriptBody: Write here — everything saves automatically as you type. Formatting lives in the toolbar above.
tour.chaptersBody: Create, rename, and reorder chapters. Word counts update live as you write.
tour.aiBody: Chat with an assistant that knows your project and characters, then insert its suggestions straight into the manuscript. Toggle it with ⌘J.
tour.storyMapBody: Plan visually: describe your story in one sentence and expand it into acts, chapters, and scenes with AI — then promote chapters back into the manuscript.

ai.greeting: Hi! I'm here to help with your writing. Ask me anything about characters, plot, style, or storytelling.
ai.promptPlot: Suggest plot twists for this scene
